scientific_limitations: Single vertex-coordinate sensor with equal observation noise on a symmetric four-node path; positive edge conductances; finite positive horizon.
General single-sensor determinant factorization and horizon-independent ranking are established prior work.

title: A complete D-optimal sensor phase diagram for four-vertex weighted diffusion paths
